parameters.content:
## P2.3A - XML Registry Sync

Reads `product_registry`, downloads the webstore XML, derives stable search fields, and writes one Google Sheets batch.

- This workflow does not create Qdrant points.
- The Redis lock expires after 15 minutes.
- Keep inactive until a manual smoke test passes.
